prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Honda Tadakatsu, matching the attached character sheet exactly.
Subject: Preserve his powerful mature face, enormous branching gold-antler kabuto, black-and-gold heavy armor, dark cloak, and round gold chest ornaments. Frame the full antler tips, face, shoulders, and upper chest.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, rich metal and lacquer detail, dramatic lighting with a clearly readable face.
Composition/framing: One person, centered bust, with visible pure-magenta margin around the full helmet and both shoulder ends.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Keep his identity, armor, antlers, and palette faithful to the reference. His weapon is a long spear; it may stay outside this head-and-shoulders crop.
Avoid: Text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped antler tips or shoulders, gradients, background shadow, watermark.
